source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Capture all relevant details in the initial inspection records. This includes the date and time of the inspection, name of the inspecting officer(s), and the specific areas or processes that were audited. Take detailed notes on each item checked and record the standard or regulation each item was checked against. Be sure to include any observations regarding compliance or non-compliance with these standards.

3. Document any violations identified.
For each violation or non-compliance identified during the audit, make detailed notes. This should include the specific regulation or standard the operation failed to meet, the location and description of the incident, and any photos or supporting documentation. Make note of any immediate hazards or risks identified.

4. Record corrective actions discussed or recommended.
During or immediately after the audit, ensure that all suggestions or mandatory corrective actions discussed are documented. Document who is responsible for these actions, proposed completion dates, and any additional resources required. 

5. Create a summary report.
Compile all
